description: Injects, manages, and clears chaos faults and network effects in LocalStack to test system resilience.

action.description: The specific chaos engineering action to perform.

latency_ms.description: Network latency in milliseconds. Required for the 'inject-latency' action.

rules.description: An array of fault rules. Required for 'inject-faults', 'add-fault-rule', and 'remove-fault-rule' actions.

items.description: A single rule defining a chaos fault.

code.description: The AWS error code to return (e.g., 'ServiceUnavailable').

statusCode.description: The HTTP status code to return (e.g., 503).

operation.description: Name of the specific service operation to affect (e.g., 'CreateBucket').

probability.description: The probability (0.0 to 1.0) of the fault occurring.

region.description: Name of the AWS region to affect (e.g., 'us-east-1').

service.description: Name of the AWS service to affect (e.g., 's3', 'lambda').

name: localstack-chaos-injector
title: LocalStack Chaos Injector
